title: The Hourglass Keeper
summary: Ha-Jun unlocks the deepest secret of Chronos-Malek's clocktower, mastering the ability to freeze localized seconds and anchor his allies from fatal wounds.

panels.shot: the cosmic eye in the sky pulsing with sickening purple radiation
panels.action: The thousand-mile eye overhead pulses, raining corrosive violet meteors across the clouds above Seoul.

panels.shot: ha-jun activating the hourglass anchor across the entire city
panels.action: Ha-Jun slams the Hourglass into the concrete pillar; a golden web of temporal wards spreads across all of Seoul.

panels.shot: falling meteors slowing to a crawl in the upper atmosphere
panels.action: Thousands of burning meteors slow to a dead halt three miles above the rooftops, frozen in suspended animation.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: As long as my mana flows, not a single civilian will die today.

panels.shot: tae-jun looking at ha-jun with stunned admiration
panels.action: Tae-Jun whistles: 'Anchoring an entire metropolitan area in a five-second time-dilation loop? You're insane, Ha-Jun.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Puri city ko time loop mein daal diya? Your mana pool is ridiculous.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto ha-jun arm: 'you must conserve energy for the prime core!'
panels.action: Kuro warns: 'Maintaining this field costs 2% of your mana per minute. We must strike the Primordial Core directly!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: We have fifty minutes before your mana depletes.

panels.shot: min-jae and baek arriving via tactical helicopter on the bridge
panels.action: A Section 9 stealth gunship lands on the intact section of Mapo Bridge; Min-Jae and Baek leap out with anti-matter launchers.

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: Supreme Commander! All world militaries have acknowledged your sovereign command!

panels.shot: global satellite feeds showing united military forces awaiting ha-jun orders
panels.action: Holographic feeds show fighter squadrons from 40 nations, hunter guilds, and demon battalions holding formation.

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: The entire planet is watching you, Ha-Jun. Give the order.

panels.shot: ha-jun broadcasting his voice across every communications channel on earth
panels.action: Through the Crown's telepathic frequency, Ha-Jun's voice echoes into eight billion human minds simultaneously.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: People of Earth. Do not despair. The darkness ends today.

panels.shot: close-ups of people worldwide looking up with hope in their eyes
panels.action: Citizens in Tokyo, New York, London, and Mumbai look up at the frozen sky, tears of hope wiping away their terror.

panels.shot: ha-jun ordering the allied forces to maintain planetary defensive shields
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'Hold your positions. Protect the innocent. Tae-Jun, Kuro, and I will pierce the Core.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Ground forces, hold the perimeter. We are going to kill God.

panels.shot: ha-jun, tae-jun, and kuro stepping to the bridge edge
panels.action: The trio stands on the edge of the abyss, wind whipping their clothes, weapons gleaming with divine energy.

panels.shot: ha-jun manifesting the full wings of the sovereign
panels.action: Six colossal wings—three of black shadow, three of golden starlight—erupt from Ha-Jun's shoulder blades.

panels.shot: tae-jun manifesting the bronze aegis armor of the guardian
panels.action: Tae-Jun is encased in magnificent full-plate armor of celestial bronze, wielding a ten-foot claymore.

panels.shot: kuro transforming into his majestic nether phoenix battle form
panels.action: Kuro expands into his 200-foot Nether Phoenix form, wreathed in violet hellfire and crimson comets.

panels.shot: the trio launching vertically toward the cosmic eye at mach 25
panels.action: With a triple sonic boom that shakes the continent, the three heroes rocket straight up toward the heavens.

panels.shot: breaching the upper stratosphere into low earth orbit
panels.action: They punch through the cloud layer into the pitch-black silence of low Earth orbit, the blue curve of Earth below.

panels.shot: before them: the primordial void entity's true form in space
panels.action: A horrifying, cosmic entity the size of the Moon—a writhing mass of black tentacles, dead worlds, and burning red eyes.

dialogue.text: THE PRIMORDIAL VOID ENTITY. EATER OF REALITIES.

panels.shot: a million-mile tentacle whipping down to swat the trio like insects
panels.action: A tentacle wider than a continent sweeps through the vacuum to crush the three warriors into cosmic dust.

panels.shot: tae-jun raising his claymore: 'aegis of the unbending brother!'
panels.action: Tae-Jun plants himself before the tentacle, deploying a 500-mile wide bronze energy shield: 'NOT ON MY WATCH!!'

panels.shot: the continent-sized tentacle bouncing off tae-jun bronze barrier
panels.action: The colossal tentacle shudders and ricochets off the bronze barrier, unable to pierce Tae-Jun's love for his brother.

panels.shot: kuro exhaling a solar flare breath that incinerates the tentacle
panels.action: Kuro swoops in, unleashing a million-degree stream of violet starlight that burns the colossal tentacle to grey ash.

panels.shot: ha-jun rocketing through the burning ash straight toward the eye core
panels.action: Ha-Jun streaks through the burning debris, drawing the Sanguine Fang overcharged with all ten Relics.

panels.shot: the primordial eye opening its central pupil firing a gamma-ray burst
panels.action: The cosmic eye fires a focused gamma-ray beam of pure anti-matter, capable of obliterating a planet.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising the hourglass of eternal abyss in both hands
panels.action: Ha-Jun holds the Hourglass before him: 'HOURGLASS: STASIS EVENT HORIZON!!'

panels.shot: the gamma-ray beam splitting into two harmless beams around the hourglass
panels.action: The planet-killing beam bends around the Hourglass's gravitational lens, curving harmlessly into empty space.

panels.shot: ha-jun arriving directly in front of the thousand-mile cosmic eye
panels.action: Ha-Jun floats inches from the colossal iris, his 6-foot frame looking microscopic yet infinitely heavier than the titan.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: You made my family bleed for seven years. Your debt is due.

panels.shot: ha-jun plunging the sanguine fang into the central pupil
panels.action: Ha-Jun drives the Sanguine Fang straight into the center of the cosmic eye with the force of an exploding star.

panels.shot: the cosmic eye screaming in silent vacuum as cracks of golden light erupt
panels.action: Fractures of pure golden starlight spiderweb across the thousand-mile entity; it thrashes in silent cosmic agony.

panels.shot: the void entity beginning to collapse in on its own gravitational center
panels.action: The Moon-sized horror begins collapsing inward like a dying star, forming a harmless miniature singularity.

panels.shot: ha-jun, tae-jun, and kuro watching the singularity seal itself cliffhanger
panels.action: The singularity snaps shut with a bright sparkle of stardust; the cosmos falls into serene, peaceful silence.
